1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein the plurality of light emitting diodes are mounted on the columnar body in a non-uniform spatial distribution pattern different from prior art configurations__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and the columnar body includes a stepped or tapered internal structure__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is integrally formed with the columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is positioned to provide directional light emission__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and are recessed into the columnar body surface__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and each fin includes a heat-dissipating surface treatment__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and includes internal ribbing__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and each diode is mounted on a separate substrate__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin is formed as an integral extension with a hollow interior__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and the diode is positioned at a specific offset distance from the center of each face__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and the material includes a ceramic composite__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, __wherein each optic element is independently removable__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes an integrated thermal interface material__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a dimming control circuit__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and includes a fresnel lens structure__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein the internal surface of the polygonal body includes a reflective coating__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __further comprising the step of applying a surface treatment to enhance thermal conductivity__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from a group consisting of copper-aluminum composites__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __and the fins are formed with a specific cross-sectional geometry optimized for heat dissipation__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and includes internal structural reinforcement elements__.
